metadata.description: Ultimatum for Claude Code. Every plugin stands alone. The core plugin handles software work; the Website, E-commerce and App Launch plugins each run a whole launch of that kind with their own business, website, social media and video teams.

plugins.name: ultimatum
plugins.description: Workflows for Claude Code. A local router reads each request and loads only the guidance it needs for coding, debugging, CI, interface work, security review and releases. Claims are backed by checks run in the session.

plugins.name: ultimatum-website-launch
plugins.description: Website Launch for Ultimatum. Plans and runs the launch of a small business, local service, portfolio or creator site: intake, business-type playbooks, page copy, local SEO and a launch checklist. Self-contained: ships its own team guides, reviewer agents and toolbelt.

plugins.name: ultimatum-ecommerce-launch
plugins.description: E-commerce Launch for Ultimatum. Plans and runs an online store launch: platform and theme choice, catalogue and product photos, payments, tax, shipping, policy pages and a first-30-days review. Self-contained: ships its own team guides, reviewer agents and toolbelt.

plugins.name: ultimatum-app-launch
plugins.description: App Launch for Ultimatum. Plans and runs the launch of a web app, mobile app or subscription product: pricing and billing, sign-up and activation, onboarding emails, trust basics and a launch-week plan. Self-contained: ships its own team guides, reviewer agents and toolbelt.
